sentence.NOT_STARTED: On the floor: not started, no scan yet.
sentence.RUNNING: On the floor: running — {done} of {of} garments done, {bundles} bundle(s) being worked since {since}.
sentence.UNDER_WAY: On the floor: under way — {done} of {of} garments done; no bundle is being worked right now.
sentence.PAUSED: On the floor: paused since {since} — {done} of {of} garments done, {paused} bundle(s) paused.
sentence.DONE: On the floor: done — {done} of {of} garments through.

held.offline: Offline: nothing changes until the connection is back.
held.readOnly: You can look at the board, not change it: changing the plan needs the permission to plan this site.
held.inWhatIf: What-if is on: apply your moves or leave what-if first.
held.whatIfReadOnly: What-if needs the permission to change the plan at this site.
held.whatIfEmpty: Try a move on the board first: nothing to apply yet.
held.pin: Pinning needs the permission to pin bars (planners and production managers).
held.pinInWhatIf: Pins are not tried in what-if: leave what-if to pin a bar.
held.outsource: Moving work to a subcontractor needs the permission to send work outside (planners, production managers, buyers).
held.partOutside: A part of an order goes to a workshop on Lines & subcontractors, not from a bar.
held.alreadyOutside: This operation is already worked at a workshop.
held.noWorkLeft: No work left on this operation.
held.workshopInWhatIf: Work is sent to a subcontractor only through Move to a subcontractor, with its kit: it is not tried in what-if.
held.workshopNotChecked: The workshops' approvals could not be read: a workshop takes no work until they are.
held.workshopNotOffered: {workshop} is not a workshop this site may send work to.

whatif.title: What-if
whatif.banner: What-if — nothing reaches the floor or other planners until you apply
whatif.bannerBody: Drag bars as you like: each move is tried privately and the board shows the plan with your moves.
whatif.empty: No move tried yet. Drag a bar on the board to see what it changes.
whatif.deltas: What changes against the working plan
whatif.planChanged: The working plan changed since you started
whatif.planChangedBody: Another planner moved something. Apply checks every move again and lists the ones that clash.
whatif.private: Only you see this what-if. It stays as a draft until you apply or discard it.
whatif.conflictsTitle_one: {moves} move clashes with the working plan
whatif.conflictsTitle_other: {moves} moves clash with the working plan
whatif.conflictsSummary: The working plan changed since you tried these moves. Apply the rest, or close and try them again on the board.
whatif.nothingElse: Every move clashes: nothing else to apply.

conflict.SLOT_GONE: The bar is no longer on the board
conflict.SLOT_MOVED: Moved by someone since you tried it
conflict.ALREADY_ON_BOARD: The operation got a bar since
conflict.NOT_OPEN: The work order is not open any more
conflict.GATE_NOT_PASSED: Its order waits on a gate not passed

log.title: Changes
log.hint: Every move with who, when and from → to. Undo goes back one change while the bar is still where it left it.
log.whatGone: Op {seq} {operation} of {order} (no longer on the work order)
log.whatGoneUnnamed: an operation of {order} (no longer on the work order)

undoHeld.NOT_UNDOABLE: A publish or an undo is not undone.
undoHeld.PART_REMOVED: A part of an order taken off is put back on Lines & subcontractors, not undone here.
undoHeld.CHANGED_SINCE: The bar changed since: only the latest change of a bar is undone, while it is where that change left it.
undoHeld.OPERATION_GONE: Its operation is no longer on the work order: the record keeps this change, but it is not undone.
undoHeld.NO_PERMISSION: Undoing this change needs the permission it was made with (a pin: the permission to pin; a move: to plan).

problem.IN_THE_PAST: {what} on {lane} was planned to end by {day} and still has work left.
problem.IN_THE_PAST_PINNED: {what} on {lane} was planned to end by {day} and still has work left; it is pinned (unpin it to reschedule it).
problem.MATERIAL_NOT_IN_TIME: {order} starts on the board before its material: the earliest start with material is {day}.
problem.MATERIAL_NOT_COVERED: {order} starts on the board while material is short with nothing ordered: {materials}.
problem.GATE_NOT_PASSED: {order} waits on a pre-production gate not passed: it starts only once the gate is passed, or started before it with a reason.

material.title: {order} would start before its material
material.notCovered: {order}: material is short with nothing ordered ({materials}): no start day with material is known.
material.body: The move is not refused: snap it to the earliest start with material, or keep your date (the problem stays in the list).
material.noDay: No day with material is known to snap to.

subcontract.title: Move Op {seq} {operation} to a subcontractor
subcontract.lead: Approved workshops only for {kind}: a workshop that is not approved shows why and cannot be picked.
subcontract.noWorkshops: This site has no workshop yet.
subcontract.noRemark: Approved for this operation; nothing to say.
subcontract.kitError: Couldn't read when the kit leaves
subcontract.kit: Kit list (from the bill of materials)
subcontract.kitNone: The bill of materials puts nothing in this kit.
subcontract.plans: It plans the subcontract order: a draft order with its kit is made for it when the work order is released; the bar moves to the workshop's lane.
subcontract.plansBuyer: It plans the work outside and moves the bar to the workshop's lane; the buyer drafts the subcontract order from Purchasing › Subcontract orders.
subcontract.already: This operation is already worked at a workshop.
subcontract.barStayed: The bar stays on its lane: {reason}

print.lanesAll: None picked: every active line of the site.

print.noVersion: No published version covers this day

sheet.lead_one: {sheets} sheet in {language}: what the PDF says.
sheet.lead_other: {sheets} sheets in {language}: what the PDF says.

backlog.title: Reschedule backlog
backlog.summary: Every unpinned bar left in the past moves to the first free time from now (and its material's day); what follows is pushed only as far as it must. Working plan only: the floor sees it once you publish.

why.PUSHED: Pushed by the operation before it

kept.PINNED_BEFORE_PREVIOUS: {order}: a pinned bar starts before the operation before it ends.
kept.NO_WORKING_TIME: {order}: no working time to move it to.

skipped.NO_WORKING_TIME: {order}: no working time on its lane.
skipped.GATE_NOT_PASSED: {order} waits on a gate not passed.

backlog.nothing: Nothing is left in the past: nothing to move.

backlog.reason_other: Why {lanes} lanes may go over capacity
